regime_context: China A-shares is in a narrow, one-narrative regime: only Coal and Banks are trend-gate eligible (2 of 22 themes), and the absolute-trend gate historically did NOT help here (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so this is an experimental/display allocation. The rotation margin is tiny (0.07) and rotation timing has no validated edge, so leadership is a coincident focus lens, not a forecast.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (cn_gold, currently ineligible, durability_bar 0.30, breadth 0.0) regains trend-gate eligibility and positive breadth — the condition to retire this watch is either the eligibility flag flipping to true with breadth above 0.3, or Gold Miners staying ineligible and negative-scored through the next two check-by dates.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme that is both rank-1 and trend-gate eligible, with a durability_bar (0.54) above its mean-revert Hurst tag threshold, suggesting the current trend may persist near-term despite the tape's whipsaw history. Breadth is middling (0.5) and crowding is absent (crowding_z 0.78, not crowded), so there is no reflexive-fade risk — but momentum rank itself has no forward edge here, so this is a durability judgment, not a momentum call.
theses.dissent: The headline is mean-revert-tagged and the absolute-trend gate did not hold on this market's history — mean-reverting A-shares history says the gate whipsaws and Coal's leadership is coincident, likely to revert quickly.

falsifier.text: Coal's proxy 515220.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 3% before Oct 23, 2026

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only other eligible theme and carries much stronger cohesion than Coal: durability_bar 0.78 on a trend tag and breadth 0.944 (nearly full participation). However it is crowded (crowding_z 1.74), which per guardrails is a size-down caution, not a fade — so the direction still leans with the trend but humility is warranted on follow-through.
theses.dissent: Crowding is elevated and the detector's validated edge is drawdown control, not return forecasting — this market's mean-reverting tape could whipsaw Banks just as it does Coal, and the crowded flag marks a possible local top.

falsifier.text: Banks' proxy 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by more than 4% while Coal outperforms before Oct 30, 2026

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is not trend-gate eligible (eligible false), crowded (crowding_z 1.39), and has weak cohesion (breadth 0.357, mixed Hurst tag) — three diminishing conditions. With the market in a narrow one-narrative regime, capital is concentrating in Coal/Banks and there is no structural reason to hold an ineligible, crowded laggard.
theses.dissent: Avoid calls have no edge from this detector; Pharma could mean-revert upward precisely because it is out of focus, and the detector only flags attention, not direction.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO's proxy 159992.SZ outperforms the CSI 300 by more than 5% before Nov 6, 2026

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
